name: reference-dark-2026-09-03
method: rendered specimens rated side by side in a browser, in a dark console, by the reference reader. Contrast was bisected to a floor and a ceiling from a ladder of ratios; the hue rule came from a chip that passed the ratio and could not be read.
source: libreadme profile reference-dark-2026-09-03.json, and bookshelf legibility/contrast.md

contrast.note: prose lives in the band. State colours are scanned rather than read; they are held to the floor, not the band.

hue.note: a contrast ratio is blind to hue. Either the hues are this far apart, or the surface is desaturated below this, so the ink's own chroma makes the edge.
